g.text: Cash creates no commission, no earning record and no stored amount. The only trace is the manual invoice amount (Dinuka).
Platform Fee = Service Amount x 5%; Total Charged = Service Amount + Platform Fee. Always recalculated on the backend.
Separate record from HomeHero's 5% revenue. Created at payment confirmation, not at booking completion.
Uses the shared personal notification service owned by Vihas.
1 category: LKR 4,999/month. 2 categories: LKR 9,998 first payment, then LKR 7,498.50 per renewal.
Applied after the 3-day grace period. The availability flag is enforced by Maheli's Go Online use case.
Consumed by Maheli's provider dashboard. Card payments only.
Consumed by Vihas's admin dashboard, 6-month revenue chart and earnings report.
